faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Got questions? We've got answers
faq.desc: Can't find what you're looking for? Contact us at support@haolixiangsong.com

items.a: Gift Haven is an invitation and task-based reward platform. Users earn points and cash rewards by completing daily tasks and inviting friends to join. Points can be redeemed for gifts or withdrawn as cash.
Completely free! Registration, task completion, and friend invitations are all free. We never charge users any fees.
There are two main ways: 1) Complete daily tasks (check-ins, watching ads, participating in events, etc.); 2) Invite friends to join and earn up to 3-tier commission.
When someone you invited (Tier 1) earns rewards, you get a commission. When people they invite (Tier 2) and their invitees (Tier 3) earn, you also get a share.

items.q: How much can I earn daily?
items.a: Earnings vary by user. Regular users can earn a few to dozens of dollars daily through tasks. Active referrers can earn significantly more passive income.
Go to 'My Account' → 'Wallet' → 'Withdraw'. We support withdrawals to bank accounts and digital wallets. Minimum withdrawal is $10, typically processed in 1-3 business days.
Regular users pay a 1% withdrawal fee. VIP members enjoy fee-free withdrawals.
Go to the 'Tasks' page and tap 'Invite Friends'. You can copy your referral link or generate a QR code to share. Anyone who registers through your link counts as your referral.

items.q: Is there a limit on invitations?
items.a: No limits! The more people you invite, the more you earn.
We currently support Android (app) and web (H5). iOS version is in development.
We use bank-grade encryption to protect user data. All transaction records are stored securely. We will never sell or leak your personal information.
